item.title: Show HN: macOS menu bar app to track Claude usage in real time
item.description:
📝 Claude Usage A lightweight macOS menubar app that displays your Claude Code usage limits at a glance. 0 (Ventura) or later Claude Code CLI installed and logged in Setup Install Claude Code if you haven't already: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code Log in to Claude Code: claude Launch Claude Usage - it will read your credentials from Keychain automatically How It Works Claude Usage reads your Claude Code OAuth credentials from macOS Keychain and queries the usage API endpoint at api. If still wrong, your Claude Code session may have expired - run claude again.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/richhickson/claudecodeusage

item.title: Texas court blocks Samsung from tracking TV viewing, then vacates order
item.description:
📝 6, 2026, 1:49 PM ET: After publishing this story, Samsung told BleepingComputer that the Texas court vacated the temporary restraining order that blocked Samsung from collecting smart TV viewing data the next day. The State of Texas obtained a short-lived, temporary restraining order (TRO) against Samsung that prohibited the South Korean company from collecting audio and visual data about what Texas consumers are watching on their TVs. The District Court of Collin County in Texas ruled that this activity violates the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act (DTPA) and ordered Samsung Electronics America Inc.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/texas-court-blocks-samsung-from-tracking-tv-viewing-then-vacates-order/
